premise.title: The Seal Beneath the Ledger
premise.logline: A novice civic registrar must document a disputed water-allocation decree without disclosing a protected informant or assigning motives without proof.
premise.immediate_objective: preserve the decree discrepancy without accusing a person or exposing sources
premise.inciting_event: Two signed copies of the city's allocation decree disagree about a single canal gate.
premise.central_problem: Is the discrepancy clerical or a deliberately concealed council amendment?
premise.wonder_or_discovery: Two signed copies of the city's allocation decree disagree about a single canal gate.
premise.stakes: An unsupported public allegation could provoke unrest; silence could preserve a corrupt policy.
constraints: A different seal cannot alone prove bribery or conspiracy.
A protected source must not be named unless the story establishes authorized release.
NPC political motives remain unproven absent independently earned evidence.
The protagonist may not alter the official archive without review.
premise.meaningful_choice_pressure: The protagonist must choose either file_bounded_discrepancy or request_authorized_reconciliation before the evidence window closes.
premise.mystery_or_forward_question: Is the discrepancy clerical or a deliberately concealed council amendment?
premise.local_payoff: Resolve exactly what can be reported from existing observations; leave cause, hidden motives and unverified future outcomes open.
persistent_outcomes_possible: An evidence-bounded report may be recorded only if produced and witnessed in the actual story.
Professional trust may shift only if the story earns that relationship change.
A future follow-up may become eligible but must not be treated as already authorized.
world_specific_elements: sealed ledgers, legal decrees, handwritten duplicates and messenger routes
none; all claims require documentary or witnessed evidence
A sealed council document is not automatically public.
